title: Leaving the Army in October 1945 and readjusting
summary: After two years, he found leaving the Army a bigger adjustment than going in and wanted to regain lost time.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: So you were in there about two years.
So you came out in late '45.
And then a couple of months later you were back in the Kirby band. What did you do when you first came out?

Well, I puttered around, you know. I was so glad to get out of the Army. I was free as a bird. I could flap my wings, you know. And it's quite an adjustment. And I think coming out of the Army was more of an adjustment than it was going in the Army, because you want to do so much.

You want to do and you want to regain what you lost in those two years, you know. And like that was two of the best years of my life, that sort of thing, you know. I wanted a car. I wanted to make a whole lot of money, you know. I wanted clothes. You know, everything. Everything. It was just a -- just a big change.
